styles.name: phone-battery
styles.description: Smartphone battery outline fills with charge; lightning bolt pulses

styles.name: wifi-connect
styles.description: WiFi arcs pulse outward while connecting, then lock solid at 100%

styles.name: bluetooth-pair
styles.description: Bluetooth rune glyph at center; handshake blips pulse outward while pairing

styles.name: disk-defrag
styles.description: Disk defrag cluster map: scattered hollow fragments ahead of the sweep, packed solid clusters behind it, with a blinking read/write head

styles.name: crt-power-on
styles.description: CRT power-on: bright center line expands vertically to fill the screen

styles.name: dialup-modem
styles.description: Dial-up modem: chaotic noise waveform settles to a clean carrier tone as progress rises

styles.name: vinyl-spin
styles.description: Vinyl record: a grooved black disc with a paper label spins up on the turntable while the tonearm tracks inward and a playback timeline fills

styles.name: drone-props
styles.description: Quadcopter seen from above: body, four arms and rotor rings whose blades spin up with progress as the drone flies across

styles.name: activity-ring
styles.description: Smartwatch activity rings: concentric red, green and blue circles close clockwise as progress grows, with matching summary bars

styles.name: usb-transfer
styles.description: USB transfer: file packets stream from the USB trident logo into a flash drive's plug; the drive fills with progress, LED blinking

styles.name: gear-train
styles.description: Gear train: a row of meshed toothed gears, large and small; progress engages them one by one (idle gears ghosted) and engaged gears counter-rotate

styles.name: eink-refresh
styles.description: E-reader page turn: the screen flashes full black, then white, then a new page of text lines appears; the location bar fills with progress
